recognize_zh: 中央一顆幼紅血球的核圓、細胞質深藍色，並在細胞質內（尤其邊緣）布滿許多小而清楚的空泡（vacuoles），左上方另有一顆類似的空泡化細胞，符合空泡化的紅血球前驅細胞（vacuolated erythroid precursors）。
features: Early erythroid precursor with a round central nucleus and a rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Numerous small, discrete, punched-out cytoplasmic vacuoles, concentrated at the periphery of the cell
A second vacuolated precursor at the upper left of the field
Cellular marrow aspirate with many erythroid and granulocytic precursors at various stages
Some precursors show coarse chromatin and nuclear irregularity; significance cannot be judged from one field
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular field containing erythroid and granulocytic precursors at various stages of maturation. An early erythroid precursor in the center has a round nucleus and deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing numerous small, discrete vacuoles, and a similarly vacuolated precursor is present at the upper left. Findings are consistent with vacuolated erythroid precursors; this change is nonspecific and may be seen with alcohol toxicity, copper deficiency or zinc excess, chloramphenicol or linezolid therapy, and in myelodysplastic neoplasms or acute erythroid leukemia, requiring clinical and laboratory correlation.

ddx.vs: Vacuoles look identical, so low serum copper and ceruloplasmin (often with neutropenia and ring sideroblasts) rather than morphology identify this cause.
Pure erythroid leukemia shows sheets of vacuolated proerythroblasts making up at least 80% of marrow cells, whereas this field contains mixed maturing lineages.
Burkitt cells also have basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm but have multiple nucleoli, are B-cell by immunophenotype and lack erythroid maturation.
Toxic vacuolation is morphologically indistinguishable and reverses on withdrawal of the agent, so exposure history is the discriminator.
